notes.title: Another game from me
notes.content:
Hi all!

A little story about myself. Because of this COVID-19 situation I lost my job. So I made another game (Stozle) in my spare time to cover my expenses while I make Cowpocalypse Episode 2. It's a smaller game, not related to CP but if you like exciting stories and sudoku puzzles check it out!

 Stozle is available also here on Steam (from May 16). 

Don't forget:  30% off on the first week!  Make sure you don't miss it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1291090/Stozle__Solve_the_Mystery/

Cheers,
Balazs

notes.title: Bad news: Indiegogo won't happen
notes.content:
It's a really depressing feeling that after a huge ammount of preparation it turns out that I can't start a campaign from my country, Hungary. 

It shocked me, because the last time I checked I was on the eligable list (about 1 year ago). I don't know if Indiegogo updated their policy since then, or I was reading an outdated info before. In any case, I can't really do anything about it. I'm sorry that I made you guys excited and now I let you down. Believe me, it's a horrible news for me too. 

I believe that honesty is the best way to go. So here it is: without support I can't make Episode 2, so it surely won't happen in the near future. I hope that in the distant future I could start working on it, because I really enjoyed the development, but it's out of my sight for now.

Thanks for all the positive feedback I got for the game so far! I whish the best for everyone and that your dreams come true!

notes.title: Episode 2 Update (2) - Indiegogo
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

The crowdfunding campaign is going to be with Indiegogo! The start date is September 7 

Long story short: 
I have already wrote the story of the second episode (it will be the last, final episode), but I can't finish it without you! I am making this game alone and the development is really time/energy/money consuming. So for the second episode to be able to exist, I need your help! With a sucessful Indiegogo campaign you can make my dream come true! 

By supporting you also could get the game (with an epic-weird-humorous story) that you've been waiting for in your whole life!

 If you are interested, tell to your friends about the game and about the upcoming campaign!


 You can still sign up with your email adress, to be the first to get all the updates about the game:
sign up (or/and click on the "Follow" at the store page)

 I will post the link to the site before the campaign starts (here + at the official website + at the Facebook page)!


Don't forget: September 7!
